name: windows-restart
title: Restart with warning
description: Schedules a restart with a warning to the signed-in user (shutdown /r /t, reason Maintenance: Planned, recorded as event 1074). Open apps are closed without saving when the time comes, so the delay is 2 to 60 minutes (default 10). Can be cancelled until then with "Cancel the restart".
measure: if ($min -lt 2 -or $min -gt 60) { Add-ArhBlocker 'The delay must be 2 to 60 minutes' }
# every signed-in session (console, Remote Desktop, a kiosk or RemoteApp shell, one whose explorer.exe stopped): the people who own its processes, and which sessions are locked

try { $procs = @(Get-Process -IncludeUserName | Where-Object { $_.SessionId -gt 0 }) } catch { $nobody = 'unknown'; Add-ArhWarning "Who is signed in could not be read ($($_.Exception.Message)): anyone signed in loses unsaved work when the restart comes" }

# a person's account is S-1-5-21-... (local or domain) or S-1-12-1-... (Entra ID); SYSTEM, services, DWM-n and UMFD-n are not. Those always translate here, so a name that does not (domain unreachable) is a person

foreach ($n in @($procs | ForEach-Object { $_.UserName } | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)) { $isPerson[$n] = $(try { ([Security.Principal.NTAccount]$n).Translate([Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value -match '^S-1-(5-21|12-1)-' } catch { $true }) }
# a process whose owner has no name (an orphaned SID, a protected process) is asked for the SID, in sessions where nobody was found yet

if ($noName.Count) { foreach ($c in @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'SessionId > 0' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $noName -contains [int]$_.ProcessId })) { if ($owners.Session -notcontains [int]$c.SessionId) { $sid = (Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $c -MethodName GetOwnerSid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Sid; if ($sid -match '^S-1-(5-21|12-1)-') { $owners += [pscustomobject]@{ User = $(try { ([Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]$sid).Translate([Security.Principal.NTAccount]).Value } catch { $sid }); Session = [int]$c.SessionId } } } } }
foreach ($s in $sessions) { if ($lockedIds -notcontains $s.Session) { Add-ArhWarning "$($s.User) is signed in (session $($s.Session)) and not locked: unsaved work is lost when the restart comes" } }
Set-ArhPlan $true "Restart in $min minutes, with a warning on screen"
apply: $msg = "ARH IT: this computer will restart in $min minutes. Please save your work now."

if ($code -eq 0) { Add-ArhNote "Restart scheduled in $min minutes" } elseif ($code -eq 1190) { Add-ArhNote 'A shutdown or restart is already scheduled' } else { Add-ArhNote "shutdown.exe exit $code $out" }
